memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land. When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you. But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.'" — Josh 24:8-10 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God recounts more victories, including a battle Israel never even saw. When King Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, the people had no idea their fate was being decided. Yet God says, "I would not listen to Balaam." Instead of a curse, blessing came, "again and again." God was protecting His people from a danger they did not even know about.

This is a wonderful comfort. How many times has God guarded us from harm we never saw coming? How many curses, so to speak, has He turned into blessings without our knowledge? We tend to thank God only for the deliverances we witness, but He is also working in the unseen places, shielding us from dangers we will never learn about until heaven.

Balaam meant to curse; God turned it to blessing. This is a pattern woven throughout Scripture, reaching its climax at the cross, where the greatest apparent defeat became our greatest blessing. What men intended for evil, God intended for good (Gen 50:20; Rom 8:28).

You may be facing opposition right now, and you cannot see how it will turn out. Trust the God who overruled Balaam. He is able to turn intended curses into blessings and to guard you in ways you cannot see. Nothing that comes against His children can finally undo His good purposes.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Can you thank God for protection you may never have been aware of?
2. How does it comfort you that God works in the unseen places?
3. Where do you need to trust God to turn an intended harm into good?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for guarding me from dangers I never even saw. When others intend harm, help me trust You to turn it into blessing for Your glory. Amen.
